data.name: Plugin_Description
data.value: Batch tasks for ICU MessageFormat messages in JSON and Java properties files: expand plural forms into one segment per CLDR category the target language needs, and restore the translated forms to whole ICU messages.

data.name: Task_Expand_Description
data.value: Expands ICU plural and selectordinal arguments into one translatable segment per CLDR category required by the target language, each a complete sentence. A restored message is laid out again with its translations.

data.name: Task_Restore_Description
data.value: Puts each expanded message back together as one segment: prunes plural branches to the target language's CLDR set, escapes ICU special characters typed as text and checks placeholder parity. Run before Generate Target Translations; Expand ICU lays the forms out again.

data.name: ViewPart_Forms_Description
data.value: Every form of the ICU message the active segment belongs to, with sample counts, the reassembled message and whether it is valid.

data.name: Action_ShowForms_Description
data.value: Show the ICU Forms window under the editor.

data.name: Verifier_Description
data.value: Checks every form of an expanded ICU message: untranslated forms, placeholders that differ from the source, a count marker typed as text, and a message that will not parse.

data.name: VerifierPage_Description
data.value: Whether the ICU verifier runs, and how each of its checks is reported.

data.name: Action_ShowSettings_Description
data.value: Open the Expand ICU and Restore ICU settings of the selected project.
